title: Reckoner about
description: A left-aligned firm statement in 32px type under a small glowing-square eyebrow, then three square white cards across the full width (stacked on phones), each with a 120px artwork top-left, a 22px title low in the card and a few lines of muted text. The statement fades in as it enters view; the cards fade in and rise 24px one after another.
notes: cards are bg-card: white on the warm page in the reckoner theme
artwork slots are 120×120 (80×80 on phones); empty, they're muted squares
CSS scroll-driven reveals (inside @supports); static HTML shows everything
